verses.text: Ayik scham heb' anima wach' spensar, malaj mach sna'an heb'. Ayik satem heb' wach' sb'eyb'al chi', malaj mach snachajel yuj to ayik scham heb' chi', skolchajkanel heb' t'a skal yahelal.
Ha heb' wach' sb'eyb'al chi', junk'olal yaj heb', wan yik'an yip heb' b'aj sk'och chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Kotanhek t'ayin a ex tze b'eyb'alej chukal, a ex ton tze b'eyb'alej ajchumal, ex tzex em ajmulal.
¿Mach heb' tze b'uchu'? ¿Mach heb' tzeyet'tej sat, tz'elta jab'an eyak' tze chakaneli? Ha ex tik te chuk ex, te esalwum ex.
Ha t'a yichtak te' ji yet' te te' k'ayum xi'il, hata' tze k'ulej ajmulal. Tzeyak'anpax heb' eyuninal silab'il t'a he diosal t'a skaltak k'e'en k'e'en t'a stitak ha' kotak ha' sb'eyi.

Ex israel, scha wal he k'ol eyoch ejmelal t'a k'e'en k'e'en nheleli sat t'a yoltak ha' kotak ha' sb'eyi, a juntzanh chi' ix he sik'kanel he diosalok. Haton t'a juntzanh chi' tze sekem wino, tzeyak'an sat eyawb'en silab'il t'ay. ¿Am he na'ani to manh ol wak'och eyahelal yuj juntzanh tas tze k'ulej chi'?
Ha t'a lum jolomtak witz te cha'anh ay ste'al, hata' tze b'o he waynub', tze nhusanpax he silab'.

Ha t'a yoloch he puerta, hata' tzeyak'och yechel he diosal yajb'entak yilji. Ha inxo tik, tzin b'atkan satk'olal eyu'uj. Tze kichanel b'eran he b'a, tzex ek' jichan t'a sat he ch'at lewan sat. Tzeyak'an he trato he mulan yet' heb' tze nib'ejochi, tzex way yet' heb'.

Tzeyik'anb'at aceite yet' jantak perfume, tzex b'at lemnaj t'a jun yechel komon Dios skuch Moloc, tzex och ejmelal t'ay. Tze chekanb'at heb' he chekab' t'a najat b'at sayanek' juntzanhxo he diosal, masanto tz'emk'och heb' b'aj ay heb' chamnak.
Tzex k'unb'i eyek' t'a najat chi', palta max nachajel jab'ok eyu'uj to malaj yelk'och jun tze k'ulej chi'. Yujto te nib'ab'il jun tze sayek' chi', yuj chi' tz'ochxi eyip, tze sayanxi.
¿Mach juntzanh heb' b'aj tzex xiwi to niwan yelk'och chi' t'ayex, yuj chi' tzin eyaktejkani, tzin b'at satk'olal eyu'uj? ¿Tom yujto manhxa tas swala', yuj chi' manhxa welk'och t'ayex?
Ha tikne'ik, ol wak' cheklaj juntzanh he b'eyb'al te wach' he na'an chi', palta manh ol ex kolchajlaj yuj.

Ayik ol el eyaw he k'anan in kolwal, ol walan t'ayex: A'okab' he komon diosal chi' tzex kolani, xin chama. Ha masanil juntzanh chi', ol ik'chajb'at yuj ik', anhej yet' jun pusok ik' chi' ol b'atok. Haxo pax heb' tzin ak'anoch yipok sk'o'ol jun, ol kajnajnhej heb' t'a in chonhab' tik, ol ajnhej heb' t'a lum tzalan wiknhej yaji, xchi Jehová.
Ol ab'jok yalchaj icha tik: B'o'ek jun b'e, te panhan tzeyutej, ik'ekel tastak ayem t'a yol b'e chi' yik wach' tzek' in chonhab', xchama.

Yujto ha Dios Haxonhej niwan Yelk'ochi, Aynhej ek' t'a junelnhej, skuchan pax Haxonhej Ochi, a tz'alan icha tik: Ha in tik, kajan in t'a lugar te cha'anh to wiknhej yaji, palta ay in pax ek' yet' heb' emnakilal yaji yet' heb' sna sb'a sk'o'ol yuj schukal, a in swiptzitej heb'.
Manhxo ol kot wowal t'a in chonhab' tik, manhxo ol wak'nhejkot wowal t'a heb' t'a junelnhej, talaj a juntzanh anima b'ob'il wuj tik, schab'axk'e sk'ol heb' t'ayin.

Yuj smul heb' israel tik yik sayannhej skomon diosal heb', ix kot wowal t'a heb', ix wak'anoch syahelal heb', ix in patikanel heb'. Palta ix spitejnhej wal sb'a heb', ix sk'ulan heb' icha tas snib'ej.
Ix wil wal sb'eyb'al heb', palta ol wanhtej heb', ol wak'an yik' yip heb'. Ol in tanhwan heb', ol wak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' skus yuj smul.
Ol walan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha ex najat kajan ex yet' ex lak'an ayex, junk'olalokab' eyaji, xin chama. Yujto a in ol wanhtej in chonhab' tik.
Palta haxo heb' chuk sb'eyb'al jun, lajan heb' icha ha' mar skot b'alb'on sat, max ochlaj wa'an, syik'ankot jantak k'alem.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, malaj jab'ok wach'il ol scha heb', xchi Jehová.
